title: Career Roadmap · Fitter
summary: A Fitter assembles, installs, aligns, maintains and repairs mechanical components, machines and industrial equipment using engineering drawings, measuring instruments and workshop tools.

facts.Course: Fitter / Turner / Machinist / Tool & Die Maker

about.label: Common pathway
about.text: Class 10 → ITI Fitter → Apprenticeship / supervised experience → Fitter → Senior Fitter / Maintenance Technician / Supervisor.

blocks.label: Entry route
blocks.text: Class 10 is the common entry route for the ITI Fitter trade; verify current admission rules.

blocks.label: Useful subjects
blocks.text: Mathematics, Science, basic mechanics and technical drawing.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Workshop practice, machine components, engineering drawings and measurement.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Precision, problem-solving, spatial reasoning, tool handling and safety.

blocks.label: Admissions
blocks.text: Check current DGT and state ITI notifications.

items.text: ITI Fitter → Mechanical assembly, fitting, installation and maintenance.
ITI Turner → Lathe operations and cylindrical component machining.
ITI Machinist → Conventional machining and precision component production.
ITI Tool & Die Maker → Tooling, dies, moulds and precision manufacturing.
Diploma in Mechanical Engineering → Further technical study and advanced technician pathways.

blocks.text: DGT’s Fitter CTS curriculum covers workshop processes, fitting operations, measurement, assembly and safety. Check the current curriculum and entry requirements before applying.

blocks.text: Verify the exact trade, current affiliation, duration, fees and admission requirements. These are options to investigate, not a ranking.

blocks.text: Check government-funded vocational training schemes and approved providers.

blocks.label: Apprenticeship
blocks.text: A stipend may apply under the registered apprenticeship contract.

blocks.label: Eligibility
blocks.text: Depends on scheme, income, category, domicile, course and institution.
Verify current official notification; no universal percentage cutoff applies.

blocks.label: Year 1
blocks.text: Workshop safety, hand tools, measurement, engineering drawings and basic fitting.

blocks.label: Year 2
blocks.text: Precision fitting, assembly, alignment, maintenance and machine components.

blocks.label: Apprenticeship
blocks.text: Practise assembly, inspection, troubleshooting and preventive maintenance under supervision.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Bench vice assembly; shaft-and-bearing assembly; precision measurement report; machine-maintenance checklist.

blocks.label: Public sector
blocks.text: Railways, defence production units, public-sector manufacturing and government workshops when vacancies are advertised.

blocks.label: Private sector
blocks.text: Automotive plants, machinery manufacturers, fabrication workshops, industrial maintenance firms and engineering companies.

blocks.label: Ideal areas
blocks.text: Mechanical assembly, equipment installation, preventive maintenance and quality inspection.
Search current opportunities through Apprenticeship India. Vacancies and selection depend on employer requirements.
Relevant programmes

items.text: Diploma in Mechatronics or Manufacturing Engineering.
Advanced vocational training in industrial maintenance.
Craft Instructor Training Scheme (CITS), subject to eligibility, for vocational teaching.

blocks.text: Institutions / resources

items.text: National Skill Training Institutes (NSTIs), where relevant programmes are available.

blocks.label: Specializations
blocks.text: Mechanical assembly, precision fitting, machine maintenance, hydraulics, pneumatics and production equipment.

blocks.label: With experience
blocks.text: Senior Fitter / Maintenance Supervisor, subject to employer requirements

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Automotive, manufacturing, heavy engineering, railways, power plants, fabrication, industrial machinery and infrastructure.
Technical skills
Tools / technologies

items.text: Bench vice, drills and fitting tools
CAD drawings and maintenance records, where used

blocks.text: Useful qualifications

items.text: Apprenticeship completion / National Apprenticeship Certificate, where applicable.
CAD / CNC training for relevant manufacturing roles.

blocks.label: Countries to explore
blocks.text: Germany, Australia, Canada, UK and New Zealand.
Training routes

blocks.label: Germany
blocks.text: Dual vocational training in industrial mechanical trades.

blocks.label: Australia
blocks.text: TAFE mechanical engineering / fitting-related trade programmes.

blocks.label: Canada
blocks.text: Public-college mechanical technician and apprenticeship pathways.

blocks.label: UK
blocks.text: Mechanical manufacturing and maintenance apprenticeships.

blocks.label: New Zealand
blocks.text: Approved mechanical engineering and fabrication training.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Academic prerequisites, language proficiency, practical training, apprenticeship requirements and qualification assessment.
An Indian ITI certificate does not automatically confer trade recognition abroad. Verify current course entry, fees and recognition requirements.

blocks.label: Roles
blocks.text: Mechanical Fitter, Assembly Technician, Maintenance Technician, Industrial Mechanic.

blocks.label: Markets
blocks.text: Germany, Australia, Canada, UK and New Zealand.
Language, trade recognition, work authorization and visa sponsorship depend on the destination and employer. Employment is not guaranteed.
